original_event.body: Fourteen H2 conflict cases per split have null single-event gold and are explicitly excluded; the invalid first adapter execution is retained and labelled. Full grids, discordance and paired bootstrap intervals are public. Cross-domain negatives all remained silent, so precision is not established. This is descriptive and does not authorize a default or architecture change.
original_event.summary: Fixed-grid comparison on H1, E6 and H2 dev/valid finds no universal default: live b=.75 lowers H1 rank recall, improves H2 depth-3 recall but loses H2-valid depth-10 recall, and its shipped evidence floor fires on zero compatible H2 positives. H1 b=0 matches frozen coverage. No profile or threshold was changed.
original_event.title: Public lexical evaluation finds suite-dependent ranking and gate behavior
